levels.name: First Tracks
levels.hook: Drive, coast, stop and reverse. See what a push does.
levels.goal: Drive the five short parts of the canyon to the finish line.
newHere: A bigger push makes you speed up faster.
Friction always pushes back against your motion, so a rover you let go of slows down.
The net force is the push minus the friction, and it sets how fast your speed changes.
levels.challenge: Stop inside the box on your first try.

levels.name: Fork in the Road
levels.hook: Two roads, one choice. Which is faster for your rover?
levels.goal: Pick a road at each of three forks and reach the finish.
newHere: Different ground grips differently: asphalt, sand, ice and mud.
A shorter road is not always the faster road.
After each fork you see the time the other road would have taken.
levels.challenge: Take the faster road at every fork.

levels.name: Push & Shove
levels.hook: Boost pads and cannons change your speed in an instant.
levels.goal: Get through the boost pads, cannons and kickers to the finish.
newHere: A sudden push, called an impulse, changes your speed by the impulse divided by your mass.
When two things collide, their total momentum (mass times velocity) stays the same.
A heavier rover changes speed less in the same hit.

levels.name: Ring Road
levels.hook: How fast can you take a bend before you slide?
levels.goal: Drive two laps of the circuit.
newHere: To go round a bend, your tyres must push you sideways towards the centre.
Tyres can give only so much sideways push, so each bend has a safe speed.
Signs show each bend's radius and the safe speed for your rover.
levels.challenge: Finish without a slide of 10° or more.

levels.name: Gravity Wells
levels.hook: Same rover, different gravity. What changes?
levels.goal: Cross the three gravity tunnels to the finish.
newHere: Your mass stays the same everywhere, but your weight changes with gravity.
More weight means more grip, and more friction too.
A boost pad adds the same speed in either lane, because mass did not change.
levels.challenge: Take the faster lane at every split.

levels.name: Crater Field
levels.hook: Roll down, climb out. Height and speed trade places.
levels.goal: Cross the hills and craters to the finish.
newHere: Going down a slope trades height for speed. Going up trades speed for height.
A slope pulls you downhill, so a steep wall needs more push than a gentle ramp.
Every crater has a steep wall and a gentle ramp as the two ways out.
levels.challenge: Climb out of the big crater by its steep wall.

levels.name: The Crossing
levels.hook: Wade, float or sink. Cross the water.
levels.goal: Cross the fords, the river and the deep channels to the finish.
newHere: Water pushes up on anything in it, with a force equal to the weight of the water pushed aside.
A rover less dense than water floats, and a floating rover has no grip.
Water also drags you back, more the faster you go.

levels.name: Polar Pass
levels.hook: Pull and push with a super electromagnet.
levels.goal: Get through the pylon pass to the finish.
newHere: Like poles repel and unlike poles attract.
The pull gets weaker the further away you are.
An electromagnet works only while its current is on.
levels.challenge: Gain speed at all three slingshots.

endless.name: Endless Canyon
endless.hook: How far can you go? Mud, gravity, boosts and cannons.
